blocks.content: We, the people of India, having solemnly resolved to constitute India into a Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic.

items: The words 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' were added to the Preamble by the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976.
Article 32 is described as the 'Heart and Soul' of the Constitution by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.
The Constituent Assembly took 2 years, 11 months, and 18 days to complete the draft.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Constitution of India is the supreme legal document governing the republic.
Drafted by the Constituent Assembly under the chairmanship of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.
Incorporates features borrowed from various global constitutions adapted for India.
Establishes a constitutional democracy with a parliamentary system of governance.
